integrity: Original analytical derivation and deterministic reproducibility checks provided. The motivating paper and classical steepest-descent step are credited; the priority comparison is necessarily non-exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact-arithmetic, worst-initial-error, one-step result for real 2 by 2 SPD systems with known eigenvalue ratio and angular-cap uncertainty; it makes no general high-dimensional or finite-precision guarantee.
title: Sharp angle-uncertainty frontier for rank-one spectral PCG preconditioning
